body:
"cygnusalbia" <cygnusalbia@myway.com> wrote in message...
>    The feeble black community's retaliations against "hate" speech
> often mentions the fact that serial killers are usually white.  This is
> true, and I would be happy to explain it.  The white brain is a complex
> machine, and when it goes wrong through mental illness or defect it
> still functions on a higher plane than the enfeebled simian brain.  To
> become a serial killer, multiple murders must be committed.  This
> requires the hiding of forensic evidence, the avoidance of leaving DNA
> and fingerprints, dental records, and the avoidance of discovery while
> disposing of a large, inert, and usually adult victim.  Serial killers,
> in addition, can put up a friendly facade, fooling people into thinking
> they are personable.

A very interesting observation, I'm not sure I ever thought of it that
way before.  In fact, one of my idols is Ted Kaczynski, the famous
Unabomber who blew up scientists and industry executives for 17 years
before being turned in by his brother.  White, incredibly intelligent
(I read he has a 170IQ), and was so smart as to hide all the evidence
as well as plant fake evidence to throw the FBI off track (e.g. on
his cross-country travels over the years he would pick up tree twigs
and stray hairs in public restrooms and included those in his bomb
packages).  I seriously doubt any African would possess the intellect
needed to get away with such crimes.  But Ted did slip up in the end,
using the odd phrasing "you can't eat your cake and have it too" in
his Manifesto that his traitorous brother recognized from a letter he
had written him.
